title: af/TelemetryDirs@1
description: `$XDG_STATE_HOME/af/telemetry-dirs.v1.json` (ADR-0151 clause 8): every telemetry directory a process wrote on this machine, by canonical absolute path, deduplicated, so the storage inventory reaches each one whatever the current level or `dir`. A directory is registered before its first write; one that overlaps another telemetry root or a directory the inventory accounts on its own is refused and never listed.
